text:
Maya: idea for Q2 webinar: run two sequential 'lab' segments in one session to target startups and enterprise buyers separately but keep a single registration. thoughts?
Jorge: yep, works for segmentation. single signup with a track choice field should be fine.
Priya: agree. we'll A/B test abstracts and CTAs in the registration flow. capture chosen track + primary pain (latency/cost/privacy).
Tom: logistics: are the labs live back-to-back or parallel breakouts? also need enough speakers.
Maya: back-to-back. plan: startup-focused practical tips first, enterprise-focused SLA/compliance second, then a unified panel. each lab has a short demo and Q.
Leah: proposed run-of-show:

00:00 - Welcome + TL;DR (Maya)
05:00 - Startup lab: quick architecture + 10m live demo (Rae)
20:00 - Enterprise lab: deployment patterns + 10m demo (Hamid)
35:00 - Ops deep-dive: batching/quantization checklist (Jorge) 10m
45:00 - Unified panel + live Q&A (Leah moderates) 20m
65:00 - Next steps + CTAs + links

Priya: marketing plan: two abstract variants (how-to vs business outcomes), 2 hero images, 2 email subject lines, 3 social captions. I'll have drafts by Tuesday.
Jorge: registration form: include hidden UTM, explicit track choice, and a short field: "most important metric" (latency/cost/throughput/security) to help SDR routing.
Tom: rehearsal plan: tech check 3 days prior, full dress 1 day prior. calendar-bot: "Tech check: 2026-03-28 09:00 UTC; Dress rehearsal: 2026-03-30 15:00 UTC"
Maya: speaker lineup: Rae (startup demo), Hamid (enterprise demo), Jorge (ops deep-dive), Leah (panel moderator). ok?
Leah: yes. I'll draft 6 cross-cutting panel questions (cost/latency/fallbacks/quantization/regression monitoring/rollouts).
Priya: let's make each lab prompt-forward: provide 2 runnable prompts in the demo and a Colab link with sandbox credits. that should boost signups and engagement.
Jorge: also include a single benchmark stat in each abstract (e.g., median 95p latency for N tokens on modeled stack) to attract technical folks. keep high-level.
Tom: fallback rules: pre-record demos + short pivot script. run-of-show should call out who triggers pivot and how (Leah to call).
Maya: action items and owners: Priya: marketing copy + assets (due Tue), Jorge: registration + UTMs + GA events (due Wed), Tom: pre-record videos + tech checklist (due Wed), Rae/Hamid/Jorge: speaker slide decks + demo scripts by EOD tomorrow, Leah: panel q list by Fri.
Rae: happy to present startup lab. will share a 5-min demo script by EOD.
Hamid: confirmed for enterprise lab, will prepare compliance slide and a fallback video.
Priya: post-event kit: Colab + 5 starter prompts + cost/latency checklist. I'll draft the kit and the post-event email.
Jorge: tracking and success metrics: registrations by track, abstract variant conversion, colab clicks, demo video plays, and MQLs attributed by "most important metric" field. define UTM campaign naming and GA events.
Maya: keep each abstract to <80 words. conversion tests show shorter works.
Priya: will run an internal poll on abstract variants before launching.
Leah: also recommend a short pre-event survey question about attendees' current deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private) to help with tailoring during the panel.
Jorge: good call. add it to the registration form.
Tom: I'll post the tech checklist in #eng-runtime and attach it to the rehearsal invite.
Maya: thanks everyone. locking plan unless anyone raises issues. :thumbsup:
Leah: excited. I'll prep moderator notes and the pivot language. :raised_hands:
